ei.title: The Power of a Mental Blueprint
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Everything in the world around us was finished in the mind of its creator before it was started. The houses we live in, the cars we drive, and our clothing — all of these began with an idea. Each idea was then studied, refined and perfected before the first nail was driven or the first piece of cloth was cut. Long before the idea was turned into a physical reality, the mind had clearly pictured the finished product. The human being designs his or her own future through much the same process. We begin with an idea about how the future will be. Over a period of time we refine and perfect the vision. Before long, our every thought, decision and activity are all working in harmony to bring into existence what we have mentally concluded about the future.

The houses we live in, the cars we drive, and our clothing — all of these began with an idea. Each idea was then studied, refined and perfected before the first nail was driven or the first piece of cloth was cut. Long before the idea was turned into a physical reality, the mind had clearly pictured the finished product. The human being designs his or her own future through much the same process. We begin with an idea about how the future will be. Over a period of time we refine and perfect the vision. Before long, our every thought, decision and activity are all working in harmony to bring into existence what we have mentally concluded about the future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① 실체가 더 중요: 본문은 아이디어(마음)의 선행을 강조

✅ ② 모든 것은 마음속에서 먼저 완성되며, 인간의 미래도 같은 방식으로 설계된다: 글의 요지 ← 정답

❌ ③ 미래가 정해져 있다: 본문과 반대(설계함)

❌ ④ 오랜 시간 뒤에: 지엽적
det.tip: finished in the mind first → 미래도 같은 방식

ch: 모든 것은 마음속에서 먼저 완성되며, 인간의 미래도 같은 방식으로 설계된다.
좋은 제품은 오랜 시간 뒤에야 떠오른다.
